judge.rationale: The candidate correctly replaces `lastUsage` with `totalUsage` and sums `inputTokens`, `outputTokens`, and `totalTokens` across all provider rounds using an `accumulateUsage` helper that preserves `undefined` when no rounds report usage. It satisfies every acceptance criterion, including renaming the hook parameter to `totalUsage` across `OrchestratorHooks`, `CLAUDE.md`, and the architecture spec, updating `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`, and keeping existing tests intact while adding thorough coverage for multi-round and partial-usage turns. The implementation is nearly identical to the reference diff in both design and behavior, differing only slightly by placing `accumulateUsage` in `orchestratorHelpers.ts` alongside `extractUsage`, keeping the new spec bullet under the existing section of `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` rather than moving it up to the main list, and splitting the multi-round acceptance tests into a dedicated test file.
